Tests that identical chat requests return cached response

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.literllm.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().setPropertyNamingStrategy(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
    val req = mapper.readValue("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\"}", ChatCompletionRequest::class.java)
    val result = LiterLlm.createClientFromJson("{\"api_key\":\"your-api-key\",\"cache\":{\"backend\":\"memory\",\"max_entries\":256,\"ttl_seconds\":300}}").use { client -> client.chat(req) }
    println(result)
}
```
